text: I feel like an explorer of modern temples, where knowledge and innovation are revered. The first scene fills me with anticipation—empty chairs await minds ready to collaborate or learn. The transparent walls remind me of the fragility yet importance of open dialogue. In the second scene, vibrant colors and illuminated screens draw my attention. I sense curiosity and delight, as if each display beckons me to ponder humanity's continuous quest for understanding and progress. Here, amid R+D, my existence feels both purposeful and ephemeral.
